title: Pakistan Independence Day
author: Marco Rubio, Secretary of State
summary:
Marco Rubio, Secretary of State

Pakistan Independence Day

Press Statement

August 13, 2026

On behalf of the United States of America, I extend warm congratulations to the people of Pakistan on their Independence Day.

Together, through our cooperation on regional mediation, critical minerals, energy, counterterrorism, cultural heritage, and trade and investment, we are turning potential into progress and delivering real results for Americans and Pakistanis alike.

On this special occasion, we commemorate the partnership between our nations and the bonds of friendship between our peoples.
